meta.project: SIGNO, team AETHER, NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
meta.method: Area-weighted (cos latitude) zone statistics over cells with a value. Descriptive only: no trend or significance test applied.
meta.ai_disclosure: Generated by the SIGNO pipeline (pipeline/), code written with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code following the team's choices; values come only from the cited NASA and Hansen/UMD datasets.

ndvi_good_share.description: Share of zone cells with pixel reliability 0 (good)

lst_night.description: Nighttime land surface temperature (to 2020, orbit drift after)

lst_clear_days.description: Mean clear-sky days behind the monthly daytime LST

et.description: Evapotranspiration, GLDAS Noah model (climate context only)
